name: Voicepanel
description:
Voicepanel runs AI-moderated voice interviews with real people. This connector
gives Claude access to your Voicepanel account, so an entire research cycle —
designing the study, recruiting participants, and reading what came back — can
happen in conversation.

Describe what you want to learn and Claude can generate a complete study: the
research objective, sections and questions, conversation guides, and follow-up
probing. Review it, edit any part of it, or have Claude score the draft and
suggest improvements before anyone sees it. Studies support stimulus media
(images, video, prototypes, websites), screen and voice recording, conditional
branching, and 30+ languages.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Voicepanel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Voicepanel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.voicepanel.com/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Voicepanel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Voicepanel lists 33 MCP tools, including create_asset_upload_url, create_intercept_distribution, create_link_distribution, create_panel_distribution, create_segmentation, create_study, create_upload_session, edit_distribution, edit_study, generate_study, get_account, and get_analysis_insight.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Voicepanel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Voicepanel in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Voicepanel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Voicepanel is developed by Voicepanel. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
